name: crispe-commit-composer-plugin
description: Turns a messy working tree into a clean, reviewable sequence of git commits. Groups changes code -> test -> doc, caps code/test commits at 10 files (doc uncapped), enforces a stable '[feature]: summary' message format per branch, verifies the build before code commits when a build system is detected, and keeps a safety tag + stash so any mid-sequence failure rolls back without losing work. Triggers on explicit commit requests: 'commit this', 'commit these changes', 'save this to git', 'check this in', 'create a commit', and Chinese equivalents like '提交代码', '提交这些改动', '帮我commit'.
